title: Bhaiya Zainab aayi hai
body:
Bhaiya Zainab aayi hai
shaam se chut ke aayi hai
chehlum karne aayi hai
1) ghazi uth kar dekh tou lo, behna ki tum halat ko, dagh rasan k layi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2) kunchao baazar gayi, mai to zaleelo qaar gayi
Qismat me ruswayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3) kaise kahu bimar ka haal, shaam me tha jo isteqbal
Sadme dil pa uthaayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Thi jo sakina khasta jigar, shaam ke zinda'n me khoo kar
bhayya behan ye aayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5) maa ki lahed par jaungi, nile rasan dikhlaaungi
kya kya ranj uthayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6) jaber ne roro ke kaha, aaye lahad par jab moula, ghamgee'n saari khudai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7) ghum me karo mil kar matam, Naaserane Aza paiham, Jab ye noha sunayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8) aye hyder ba aaho buka, tu ne likha jo ye nouha
girya saari khudayi hai
